steps.code:
access_token = login_resp['access_token']
# Get sent transactions for this month (May 2023)
transactions = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    resp = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=access_token,
        direction='sent',
        min_created_at='2023-05-01',
        max_created_at='2023-05-31',
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20
    )
    if 'message' in resp:
        print("Error:", resp)
        break
    transactions.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print("Number of sent transactions this month:", len(transactions))
# Extract receiver emails
receiver_emails = set()
for t in transactions:
    receiver_emails.add(t['receiver']['email'])
print("Receiver emails:", receiver_emails)
